ValidationRule.description: If manager want to change Task status to complete then need to add comment.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Completed"), Candidates_to_submit__c > Actual_Candidate_submitted__c, ISBLANK( Manager_Comment__c ), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Recruiter_Page_Layout", $UserRole.DeveloperName = "SVPHumanResources" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Manager need to add comment before setting status to "Complete".
